content: Do not store this medication in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product has expired or is no longer needed, ensure it is discarded properly. Store the medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not keep it in the bathroom. Follow proper disposal methods for expired or unused products. This information was last updated in May 2024.
